QuestInfo.name: [MapleStory X Evangelion] Omega Sector Power Supply
QuestInfo.0: There seems to be a problem over in Omega Sector. You'd better talk to Dr. Kim and find out what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Kim says the Omega Sector is desperate for electricity. You'll have to hold on to the #b#i3996150# #t3996150##k for 30 minutes to charge it for use! Then you can deliver it to Dr. Kim.
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to you, the Omega Sector got enough electricity to keep things going for another day, but they're sure to need more tomorrow.
